WITH rj_orders AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) AS purchase_date,
    CASE
      WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-06-12' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-07-01' THEN 'window'
      WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-06-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-06-12' THEN 'baseline'
    END AS period
  FROM orders.orders o
  JOIN orders.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  WHERE c.customer_state = 'RJ'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-06-01'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-07-01'
),
order_payment AS (
  SELECT
    ro.order_id,
    ro.purchase_date,
    ro.period,
    SUM(p.payment_value) AS order_payment
  FROM rj_orders ro
  JOIN payments.order_payments p ON p.order_id = ro.order_id
  GROUP BY ro.order_id, ro.purchase_date, ro.period
),
order_seller AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    op.order_id,
    op.purchase_date,
    op.period,
    op.order_payment,
    oi.seller_id
  FROM order_payment op
  JOIN orders.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = op.order_id
),
order_category AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    op.order_id,
    op.purchase_date,
    op.period,
    op.order_payment,
    pr.product_category_name
  FROM order_payment op
  JOIN orders.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = op.order_id
  JOIN orders.products pr ON pr.product_id = oi.product_id
),
seller_daily AS (
  SELECT seller_id, period, purchase_date, SUM(order_payment) AS daily_rev
  FROM order_seller
  GROUP BY seller_id, period, purchase_date
),
seller_period AS (
  SELECT seller_id, period, SUM(daily_rev) AS period_rev
  FROM seller_daily
  GROUP BY seller_id, period
),
seller_both AS (
  SELECT
    b.seller_id,
    b.period_rev AS baseline_rev,
    w.period_rev AS window_rev
  FROM seller_period b
  JOIN seller_period w ON w.seller_id = b.seller_id AND w.period = 'window'
  WHERE b.period = 'baseline'
),
category_daily AS (
  SELECT product_category_name, period, purchase_date, SUM(order_payment) AS daily_rev
  FROM order_category
  GROUP BY product_category_name, period, purchase_date
),
category_period AS (
  SELECT product_category_name, period, SUM(daily_rev) AS period_rev
  FROM category_daily
  GROUP BY product_category_name, period
),
category_both AS (
  SELECT
    b.product_category_name,
    b.period_rev AS baseline_rev,
    w.period_rev AS window_rev
  FROM category_period b
  JOIN category_period w ON w.product_category_name = b.product_category_name AND w.period = 'window'
  WHERE b.period = 'baseline'
),
period_seller AS (
  SELECT
    period,
    SUM(daily_rev) AS total_rev,
    COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) AS active_sellers,
    COUNT(DISTINCT purchase_date) AS n_days
  FROM seller_daily
  GROUP BY period
),
period_category AS (
  SELECT
    period,
    COUNT(DISTINCT product_category_name) AS active_categories
  FROM category_daily
  GROUP BY period
),
seller_stats AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS n_sellers,
    SUM(CASE WHEN window_rev < baseline_rev THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_sellers_decreased
  FROM seller_both
),
category_stats AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS n_categories,
    SUM(CASE WHEN window_rev < baseline_rev THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_categories_decreased
  FROM category_both
)
SELECT
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN ps.period = 'window' THEN ps.total_rev::DOUBLE / NULLIF(ps.n_days, 0) END), 2) AS value,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN ps.period = 'baseline' THEN ps.total_rev::DOUBLE / NULLIF(ps.n_days, 0) END), 2) AS baseline,
  ROUND(
    MAX(CASE WHEN ps.period = 'window' THEN ps.total_rev::DOUBLE / NULLIF(ps.n_days, 0) END)
    - MAX(CASE WHEN ps.period = 'baseline' THEN ps.total_rev::DOUBLE / NULLIF(ps.n_days, 0) END),
    2
  ) AS diff,
  MAX(CASE WHEN ps.period = 'window' THEN ps.active_sellers END) AS window_active_sellers,
  MAX(CASE WHEN ps.period = 'baseline' THEN ps.active_sellers END) AS baseline_active_sellers,
  MAX(CASE WHEN pc.period = 'window' THEN pc.active_categories END) AS window_active_categories,
  MAX(CASE WHEN pc.period = 'baseline' THEN pc.active_categories END) AS baseline_active_categories,
  ROUND(MAX(ss.n_sellers_decreased)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(MAX(ss.n_sellers), 0), 4) AS share_sellers_decreased,
  ROUND(MAX(cs.n_categories_decreased)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(MAX(cs.n_categories), 0), 4) AS share_categories_decreased
FROM period_seller ps
JOIN period_category pc ON pc.period = ps.period
CROSS JOIN seller_stats ss
CROSS JOIN category_stats cs;
